failure_description: High-vacuum thermal cycling (10^-5 Torr, -20C to +60C) cannot be executed in standard university/ground laboratory.
root_cause: Requires cryogenic high-vacuum thermal chamber with liquid nitrogen cold-plate infrastructure.
corrective_action: Formal TVAC Test Plan (ASTRA-QTP-TVAC-001) authored; conductive heat sink envelope verified by numerical analysis.
